title: Altri Verbi Irregolari al Presente
subtitle: Dire, venire, uscire, dare, stare, sapere — the rest of Italian's everyday irregulars.
objectives: Conjugate dire, venire, uscire, dare, stare and sapere in the present
Distinguish sapere (to know facts/how to) from conoscere (to know people/places)
Recognize stare in fixed expressions and the progressive form

content.intro: Alongside andare, fare and volere, a second wave of irregular verbs — dire, venire, uscire, dare, stare, sapere — appears constantly in everyday Italian.
content.explanation: These verbs don't share one single pattern, so it's most efficient to learn them as a set through repeated use. Two are worth a special note: stare is the base of the progressive form (sto mangiando, I am eating) and of asking how someone is (Come stai?); and Italian splits English's single verb "to know" into two: sapere (facts, information, skills — often + infinitive) and conoscere (people, places — a regular -ere verb, covered alongside sapere here for contrast).

rules.heading: a) Sapere vs. conoscere
rules.body:
• sapere + fact/information: So che parli italiano. (I know that you speak Italian.)
  • sapere + infinitive = to know how to: So nuotare. (I know how to swim.)
  • conoscere + person/place: Conosco Marco. Conosco Roma bene.

rules.heading: b) Stare — health, staying, and the progressive
rules.body:
• Health: Come stai? Sto bene.
  • To stay/remain: Stiamo a casa stasera.
  • Progressive (stare + gerund, full detail at C1): Sto studiando. (I am studying [right now].)

examples.en: What are you saying? I didn't understand.
I'm coming to the party with Marco.
I'm going out with friends tonight.
I don't know where the office is.

examples.it: Conosco un buon ristorante qui vicino.
examples.en: I know a good restaurant near here.

commonMistakes.why: A fact/piece of information needs sapere, not conoscere.
Knowing a person needs conoscere, not sapere.
The io form of sapere is so, an irregular one-syllable form, not sao.

items.explanation: Tu form of venire is vieni.
Noi form of sapere is sappiamo.
Loro form of uscire is escono.
Sapere + infinitive = to know how to.

summary: Dire, venire, uscire, dare, stare and sapere are irregular and must be memorized individually.
Stare covers health (Come stai?), staying/remaining, and is the base of the progressive form.
